# Stormberry AS - Operational AI Partner

> Stormberry AS is an operational AI partner based in Norway, delivering AI capabilities that integrate directly into daily operations, sales pipelines, and strategic planning, across cultures and languages.

## About Us
Founded by Marcos Thomassen Povoa after 14 years in industrial and maritime sales. We help businesses structure their sales and strategy in a global context and run a continuous AI loop to keep that structure sharp. We are sovereign by default: your data remains on your infrastructure, and agents run behind your firewall.

## The Loop
Our AI practice operates in three continuous motions:

1. **Daily Operations (Motion 1)**: AI handles reporting, data cleaning, maintenance planning, and customer communication. This includes specialized corporate training to comply with EU AI Act Article 4 (AI Literacy & Compliance).
2. **Sales Pipeline (Motion 2)**: AI scores every deal against your strategic priorities, highlighting opportunities that align with your actual goals. Less time on noise, more on the right deals.
3. **Strategy (Motion 3)**: A field-intelligence synthesis ready for your next strategy review. We use actual pipeline and operations data to update the strategy, turning it into a description of reality plus an aim, rather than a wish list.

## Global Delivery
Cross-cultural communication is built into every motion of our loop. We operate natively in four languages: English, Norwegian, Portuguese, and French. Our deliverables adapt to local communication styles, whether direct in Oslo, warm in Rio, or indirect in Tokyo.
